text: Based on the output from the FIRMS detections tool, there were no thermal anomaly detections recorded within the property during the period from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. All relevant sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the asset area during this period, but no intersections with detected thermal anomalies were found.
